body: Green dust sits in the tire pump's nozzle. The tarp around it is streaked. Maybe a wheel crossed from one field to another.
title: Tire pump and tarp

body: This shovel carries two soils. There's red clay under a fresh layer of pale spray dust. The bucket holds only the pale dust and a few yellowed seedlings.
title: Shovel and bucket

body: This shovel's been in the fertilizer. The handle has paint from another barn.
title: Shovel and fertilizer

body: The duct tape holds a split spray hose together. Its inner edge is green. The water bottle beneath the patch is flecked the same way.
title: Duct tape, hose and water bottle

body: The tarp's blue weave is stiff with dried yellow residue. Rope burns show where it was lashed down tight over something. Whatever was underneath left those streaks.
title: Tarp and rope

body: The seed bag is ripped open. Black dust coats the tarp underneath. Same dust I saw on those dead crops last week.
title: Seed bag and tarp

body: Someone tied this broom to the outside of a load. Its bristles hold straw from one pen and dark treated-seed pellets. A few scorched crop leaves are caught in the twine.
title: Broom and twine

body: The bucket's full of green chemical residue, still wet. The rubber hose drips concentrate onto withered leaves below. Someone left it running.
title: Rubber hose and bucket

body: The rope has chemical burns where it touched the seed bag. Both reek of something harsh. This got hauled from the field to town.
title: Rope and seed bag

body: The spade blade was rinsed. Green soil is left in the socket where the water couldn't reach.
title: Hand shovel and water bottle
